action_item:
1. Ask the customer (over email) which disease they want to add and request any related medical documents they have.
2. Raise the request through the endorsement module and send it to the insurer.
3. The insurer may ask for additional medical documents - collect them from the customer if not already received.
4. Send the documents to the insurer. Their underwriting team will decide whether to accept the PED or not.
5. Share the endorsement TAT with the customer (standard TAT: 7-10 working days).
6. Once the insurer shares the Endorsed Letter or updated Policy Copy, validate it and share it with customer to close the ticket.


Mandatory Documents: First Consultation Paper (FCP), Medical History Paper, Lab Test Reports, and Latest Prescription (if applicable).

Things to remember: Customer’s written consent from their registered email ID is mandatory. The customer must mention the exact diagnosis in the email body along with the disease history.

NOTE-  Always collect the required documents in advance.
structured_sop_yaml:
steps:
- name: Collect Disease Details and Medical Documents from Customer
  actor: Advisor
  to: Customer
  trigger: Customer requests PED addition or advisor initiates PED addition process
  sub_steps:
  - id: '1.1'
    action: Send email to customer asking which disease they want to add
    required: Yes (Mandatory)
    validation: Verify email sent to customer's registered email ID
    note: Ensure email is sent to the customer's registered email ID
    on_error: Resend email or follow up with customer
  - id: '1.2'
    action: Request customer to share related medical documents (FCP, Medical History
      Paper, Lab Test Reports, Latest Prescription if applicable)
    required: Yes (Mandatory)
    validation: Verify all required documents are received
    note: Collect all mandatory documents in advance
    on_error: Follow up with customer for missing documents
  - id: '1.3'
    action: Request customer to provide written consent from their registered email
      ID
    required: Yes (Mandatory)
    validation: Verify consent received from registered email ID
    note: Consent must mention exact diagnosis and disease history in email body
    on_error: Request customer to resend consent with required details
  - id: '1.4'
    action: Verify that customer has mentioned exact diagnosis and disease history
      in the email body
    required: Yes (Mandatory)
    validation: Check email content for diagnosis and disease history
    note: Do not proceed without complete information
    on_error: Ask customer to update email with required details
  decisions:
  - when: 1.1 = false or 1.2 = false or 1.3 = false or 1.4 = false
    action: Follow up with customer for missing information or documents
    status: null
  - when: All sub-steps complete
    action: Proceed to STEP_2
    status: null
- name: Raise Endorsement Request and Send to Insurer
  actor: Advisor
  to: Insurer (via System)
  trigger: All required documents and consent received from customer
  sub_steps:
  - id: '2.1'
    action: Raise PED addition request through endorsement module
    required: Yes (Mandatory)
    validation: Verify request is logged in the system
    note: Use insurer's endorsement module
    on_error: Retry submission or escalate to technical support
  - id: '2.2'
    action: Attach all collected documents to the request
    required: Yes (Mandatory)
    validation: Check all mandatory documents are attached
    note: Ensure no document is missing
    on_error: Attach missing documents and resubmit
  - id: '2.3'
    action: Submit the request to the insurer
    required: Yes (Mandatory)
    validation: Confirm submission acknowledgment from insurer/system
    note: Keep submission confirmation for records
    on_error: Resubmit or contact insurer support
  decisions:
  - when: 2.1 = false or 2.2 = false or 2.3 = false
    action: Review and correct errors, then retry submission
    status: null
  - when: All sub-steps complete
    action: Proceed to STEP_3
    status: null
- name: Handle Additional Document Requests from Insurer
  actor: Advisor
  to: Customer
  trigger: Insurer requests additional medical documents
  sub_steps:
  - id: '3.1'
    action: Inform customer about additional documents required by insurer
    required: Conditional
    validation: Verify customer is notified
    note: Specify exactly which documents are needed
    on_error: Follow up with customer
  - id: '3.2'
    action: Collect additional documents from customer
    required: Conditional
    validation: Verify receipt of requested documents
    note: Check for completeness and clarity
    on_error: Request again or escalate if not received
  - id: '3.3'
    action: Confirm all additional documents are received and complete
    required: Conditional
    validation: Check all insurer-requested documents are present
    note: Do not proceed until all documents are received
    on_error: Follow up with customer
  decisions:
  - when: 3.1 = false or 3.2 = false or 3.3 = false (if insurer requests additional
      docs)
    action: Continue following up with customer until all documents are received
    status: null
  - when: All sub-steps complete or no additional documents requested
    action: Proceed to STEP_4
    status: null
- name: Send Documents to Insurer for Underwriting Decision
  actor: Advisor
  to: Insurer
  trigger: All required and additional documents collected
  sub_steps:
  - id: '4.1'
    action: Send all collected documents to insurer
    required: Yes (Mandatory)
    validation: Verify documents sent and acknowledged by insurer
    note: Include any newly received documents
    on_error: Resend documents or contact insurer
  - id: '4.2'
    action: Confirm insurer's underwriting team has received documents
    required: Yes (Mandatory)
    validation: Obtain confirmation from insurer
    note: Follow up if no acknowledgment received
    on_error: Follow up with insurer
  decisions:
  - when: 4.1 = false or 4.2 = false
    action: Resend documents or follow up with insurer
    status: null
  - when: All sub-steps complete
    action: Proceed to STEP_5
    status: null
- name: Share Endorsement TAT with Customer
  actor: Advisor
  to: Customer
  trigger: Request submitted to insurer and documents sent
  sub_steps:
  - id: '5.1'
    action: Inform customer of standard endorsement TAT (7-10 working days)
    required: Yes (Mandatory)
    validation: Verify customer is notified via email or preferred channel
    note: Set customer expectations for processing time
    on_error: Resend TAT information or follow up with customer
  decisions:
  - when: 5.1 = false
    action: Resend TAT information to customer
    status: null
  - when: All sub-steps complete
    action: Proceed to STEP_6
    status: null
- name: Validate and Share Endorsed Letter/Updated Policy Copy with Customer
  actor: Advisor
  to: Customer
  trigger: Insurer shares Endorsed Letter or updated Policy Copy
  sub_steps:
  - id: '6.1'
    action: Validate the received Endorsed Letter or updated Policy Copy for accuracy
      and completeness
    required: Yes (Mandatory)
    validation: Check document details match requested PED addition and customer information
    note: Ensure no errors or omissions in the document
    on_error: Contact insurer for corrections
  - id: '6.2'
    action: Share the validated document with the customer
    required: Yes (Mandatory)
    validation: Confirm customer has received the document
    note: Send via customer's registered email ID
    on_error: Resend document or follow up with customer
  - id: '6.3'
    action: Close the ticket in the system
    required: Yes (Mandatory)
    validation: Verify ticket status is updated to closed
    note: Ensure all customer queries are resolved before closure
    on_error: Update ticket status and notify customer if needed
  decisions:
  - when: 6.1 = false
    action: Contact insurer for corrections before proceeding
    status: null
  - when: 6.2 = false
    action: Resend document or follow up with customer
    status: null
  - when: 6.3 = false
    action: Update ticket status and ensure closure
    status: null
  - when: All sub-steps complete
    action: 'STATUS: COMPLETED'
    status: COMPLETED

  To: Customer

      Note: Consent must come from the email ID registered with the policy
      On Error: Follow up with customer and request again
    - 1.2: Request customer to provide details to be changed
      Required: Yes (Mandatory)
      Validation: Check that all required change details are provided
      Note: Details should clearly specify the changes required in the policy
      On Error: Ask customer to clarify or provide missing details

      Required: Yes (Mandatory)
      Validation: Verify that a valid government ID proof is received and matches the customer
      Note: Acceptable ID proofs: Aadhaar, PAN, Passport, etc.
      On Error: Request customer to resend valid ID proof

    - WHEN: 1.1 = false
      ACTION: Follow up with customer for written consent
    - WHEN: 1.2 = false
      ACTION: Request customer to provide complete change details
    - WHEN: 1.3 = false
      ACTION: Request customer to provide valid government ID proof
    - WHEN: All sub-steps complete
      ACTION: Proceed to STEP_2

  To: Insurer

PB Manual - Ticketing Process:

1. Ask the customer to share a written consent from the registered email ID along with the new email id details.

3. If the existing email ID is no longer accessible, we can update it in real time in BMS [Because the first-step verification OTP link is triggered on the registered email ID] and process the endorsement simultaneously.

2. Raise the request through the endorsement module and send it to the insurer.

Mandatory Documents: PED Performa needs to be filled with exact PED details and date of diagnosis, First Consultation Paper (FCP), Medical History Paper, Lab Test Reports, and Latest Prescription (if applicable).

NOTE-  Always collect the required documents in advance.

- name: Collect PED Addition Details and Documents from Customer
  actor: Advisor
  to: Customer
  trigger: Customer requests PED addition or advisor identifies need for PED addition

    action: Send email to customer asking which disease they want to add
    required: Yes (Mandatory)
    validation: Verify email sent to customer's registered email ID
    note: Request customer to reply from their registered email ID for written consent
    on_error: Resend email or follow up with customer
  - id: '1.2'

      FCP, Medical History Paper, Lab Test Reports, Latest Prescription if applicable)
    required: Yes (Mandatory)
    validation: Verify receipt of all required documents
    note: List all mandatory documents in the email; collect in advance if possible
    on_error: Follow up with customer for missing documents
  - id: '1.3'
    action: Request customer to mention exact diagnosis and disease history in the
      email body
    required: Yes (Mandatory)
    validation: Check email content for diagnosis and history details
    note: Exact PED details and date of diagnosis must be included
    on_error: Request customer to resend email with required details
  - id: '1.4'
    action: Obtain customer's written consent from their registered email ID
    required: Yes (Mandatory)
    validation: Verify email is from registered email ID and includes consent
    note: Consent is mandatory for processing
    on_error: Request customer to resend consent from registered email ID

  - when: 1.1 = false or 1.2 = false or 1.3 = false or 1.4 = false

    status: null

  - id: '1.2'
    action: Check applicable policy T&C for exclusion eligibility
    required: Yes (Mandatory)

  - when: 4.2 = false

    status: null
  - when: 4.3 = false

    status: null
  - when: All sub-steps complete
    action: Proceed to STEP_5
    status: null

2. Raise the request through the endorsement module and send it to the insurer.
3. The insurer may ask for additional medical documents — collect them from the customer if not already received.

5. Share the Endorsement Letter (EL) with the customer once the process is completed.

action_item:
1. Ask the customer (over email) which disease they want to add and request any related medical documents they have.
2. Raise the request to the insurer via email (Insurer Email ID – Channel Assist Team) and attach the customer’s consent along with the medical documents.
3. The insurer may ask for additional medical documents — collect them from the customer if not already received.
4. Send the documents to the insurer. Their underwriting team will decide whether to accept the PED or not.
5. Share the Endorsement Letter (EL) with the customer once the process is completed.


Mandatory Documents: First Consultation Paper (FCP), Medical History Paper, Lab Test Reports, and Latest Prescription (if applicable).

Things to remember: Customer’s written consent from their registered email ID is mandatory. The customer must mention the exact diagnosis in the email body along with the disease history.

NOTE-  Always collect the required documents in advance, Follow up with the insurer over email, making sure they mention the Service ID in the email subject.

  - id: '1.2'

    status: null

action_item:
1. Ask the customer (over email) which disease they want to add and request any related medical documents they have.
2. Raise the request through the endorsement module and send it to the insurer.
3. The insurer may ask for additional medical documents — collect them from the customer if not already received.
4. Send the documents to the insurer. Their underwriting team will decide whether to accept the PED or not.
5. Share the Endorsement Letter (EL) with the customer once the process is completed.


Mandatory Documents: First Consultation Paper (FCP), Medical History Paper, Lab Test Reports, and Latest Prescription (if applicable).

Things to remember: Customer’s written consent from their registered email ID is mandatory. The customer must mention the exact diagnosis in the email body along with the disease history.

NOTE-  Always collect the required documents in advance.

    required: Yes (Mandatory)
    validation: Verify email sent to customer's registered email ID
    note: Use customer's registered email ID for all communication
    on_error: Resend email or contact customer via alternate channel
  - id: '1.2'
    action: Request customer to provide written consent from their registered email
      ID
    required: Yes (Mandatory)
    validation: Check for explicit written consent in customer's reply from registered

      email body

    on_error: Request missing or unclear documents from customer

  - when: 1.1 = false

    status: null
  - when: 1.2 = false
    action: Follow up with customer for written consent
    status: null
  - when: 1.3 = false
    action: Request customer to resend email with required details
    status: null
  - when: 1.4 = false
    action: Request missing or unclear documents from customer
    status: null
  - when: All sub-steps complete
    action: Proceed to STEP_2
    status: null

  - id: '1.2'

    required: Yes (Mandatory)

  - when: 1.2 = false

    status: PENDING
  - when: All sub-steps complete
    action: Proceed to STEP_2

1. Mid-term member exclusion is not allowed; as an exception, it can only be raised in case of the demise of the insured member.

2. Ask the customer/family member to share written consent along with the Death Certificate, as applicable based on the policy T&C.

3. Share the endorsement TAT with the customer (standard TAT: 7–10 working days).

5. Refund of the paid premium is subject to the policy T&C.

  actor: Advisor
  to: Advisor
  trigger: Customer requests member exclusion during policy term

    action: Verify if the exclusion request is due to the demise of the insured member
    required: Yes (Mandatory)
    validation: Confirm supporting information or documentation of demise
    note: Mid-term exclusion is only allowed in case of demise as per Go Digit policy
      T&C
    on_error: Inform customer that exclusion is not permitted except in case of demise
  - id: '1.2'
    action: Check policy T&C for any additional requirements or exceptions
    required: Yes (Mandatory)
    validation: Review policy document for relevant clauses
    note: Policy T&C may vary by policy type (Individual/Family Floater)
    on_error: Escalate to insurer or internal expert for clarification
  decisions:
  - when: 1.1 = false
    action: Inform customer that mid-term exclusion is not allowed except in case
      of demise
    status: STOP
  - when: 1.2 = false
    action: Escalate to insurer or internal expert for clarification
    status: PENDING
  - when: All sub-steps complete
    action: Proceed to STEP_2
    status: ''

  actor: Advisor
  to: Customer/Family Member
  trigger: Eligibility for exclusion due to demise is confirmed

  - id: '2.2'

    required: Conditional
    validation: Verify authenticity and completeness of Death Certificate
    note: Required if applicable as per policy T&C

  - id: '2.3'

    required: Yes (Mandatory)
    validation: Ensure all required documents are collected as per policy

  - when: All sub-steps complete

  - when: 3.1 = false

    status: PENDING
  - when: All sub-steps complete
    action: Proceed to STEP_4
    status: ''

    note: Ensure endorsement reflects requested changes
    on_error: Contact insurer for correction or clarification
  - id: '4.2'

    required: Yes (Mandatory)
    validation: Confirm customer has received the document
    note: This action closes the ticket
    on_error: Resend document or follow up with customer
  decisions:
  - when: 4.1 = false
    action: Contact insurer for correction or clarification
    status: PENDING

    action: Resend document or follow up with customer
    status: PENDING
  - when: All sub-steps complete
    action: Proceed to STEP_5
    status: ''

  actor: Advisor

action_item:
1. Ask the customer (over email) which disease they want to add and request any related medical documents they have.
2. Raise the request through the endorsement module and send it to the insurer.
3. The insurer may ask for additional medical documents — collect them from the customer if not already received.
4. Send the documents to the insurer. Their underwriting team will decide whether to accept the PED or not.
5. Share the Endorsement Letter (EL) with the customer once the process is completed.


Mandatory Documents: First Consultation Paper (FCP), Medical History Paper, Lab Test Reports, and Latest Prescription (if applicable).

Things to remember: Customer’s written consent from their registered email ID is mandatory. The customer must mention the exact diagnosis in the email body along with the disease history.

NOTE-  Always collect the required documents in advance.

    validation: Verify email sent to customer's registered email ID
    note: Use customer's registered email ID for all communication
    on_error: Resend email or follow up with customer
  - id: '1.2'

      ID

    action: Request customer to mention exact diagnosis and disease history in the
      email body

    validation: Review email for diagnosis and disease history details
    note: Diagnosis and history must be clearly stated
    on_error: Ask customer to provide missing details

action_item:
1. Ask the customer (over email) which disease they want to add and request any related medical documents they have.
2. Raise the request through the endorsement module and send it to the insurer.
3. The insurer may ask for additional medical documents — collect them from the customer if not already received.
4. Send the documents to the insurer. Their underwriting team will decide whether to accept the PED or not.
5. Share the Endorsement Letter (EL) with the customer once the process is completed.


Mandatory Documents: First Consultation Paper (FCP), Medical History Paper, Lab Test Reports, and Latest Prescription (if applicable).

Things to remember: Customer’s written consent from their registered email ID is mandatory. The customer must mention the exact diagnosis in the email body along with the disease history.

NOTE-  Always collect the required documents in advance.

    action: Ask customer via email to specify the disease to be added
    required: Yes (Mandatory)
    validation: Check that customer replies with the disease name and exact diagnosis
      in the email body
    note: Customer must mention exact diagnosis and disease history in the email body;
      request from registered email ID
    on_error: Follow up with customer for missing or incomplete information
  - id: '1.2'
    action: Request customer to provide written consent from their registered email
      ID
    required: Yes (Mandatory)
    validation: Verify consent is received from registered email ID
    note: Consent is mandatory for processing PED addition
    on_error: Request customer to resend consent from registered email ID
  - id: '1.3'
    action: Request customer to share all mandatory medical documents (FCP, Medical
      History Paper, Lab Test Reports, Latest Prescription if applicable)
    required: Yes (Mandatory)
    validation: Check that all required documents are received and complete
    note: Collect all documents in advance; latest prescription only if applicable
    on_error: Request missing documents from customer
  decisions:
  - when: 1.1 = false
    action: Follow up with customer for disease details and diagnosis
    status: null
  - when: 1.2 = false
    action: Request written consent from registered email ID
    status: null
  - when: 1.3 = false
    action: Request missing mandatory documents from customer
    status: null
  - when: 1.1 = true AND 1.2 = true AND 1.3 = true
    action: Proceed to STEP_2
    status: null

  actor: Advisor
  to: Insurer (via System)
  trigger: All required details and documents received from customer
  sub_steps:

    action: Raise PED addition request through endorsement module in the system
    required: Yes (Mandatory)
    validation: Verify request is logged in the system with correct details
    note: Ensure all customer-provided information is entered accurately
    on_error: Correct errors and re-submit request
  - id: '2.2'
    action: Attach and send all collected documents to the insurer via the system
    required: Yes (Mandatory)
    validation: Confirm all documents are uploaded and sent successfully
    note: Double-check document completeness before submission
    on_error: Re-upload and resend missing or incomplete documents
  decisions:
  - when: 2.1 = false

    status: null
  - when: 2.2 = false

  - when: 2.1 = true AND 2.2 = true

    status: null

    note: Be specific about what is missing or required

    action: Collect additional documents from customer
    required: Conditional
    validation: Verify receipt and completeness of additional documents
    note: Ensure documents are as per insurer’s request
    on_error: Request again or escalate if customer is unresponsive
  - id: '3.3'
    action: Send additional documents to insurer
    required: Conditional
    validation: Confirm documents are sent to insurer and acknowledged
    note: Send promptly to avoid delays
    on_error: Resend if not acknowledged by insurer

  - when: 3.1 = false OR 3.2 = false
    action: Follow up with customer for pending documents
    status: null
  - when: 3.3 = false
    action: Resend documents to insurer
    status: null
  - when: 3.1 = true AND 3.2 = true AND 3.3 = true OR No additional documents requested
    action: Proceed to STEP_4
    status: null

  actor: Insurer
  to: Advisor
  trigger: All required documents submitted to insurer
  sub_steps:
  - id: '4.1'
    action: Underwriting team reviews documents and decides on PED acceptance
    required: Yes (Mandatory)
    validation: Receive official communication of decision from insurer
    note: Decision may be acceptance or rejection of PED addition
    on_error: Follow up with insurer for status update if delayed
  decisions:
  - when: 4.1 = false
    action: Follow up with insurer for underwriting decision
    status: null
  - when: 4.1 = true
    action: Proceed to STEP_5
    status: null
- name: Share Endorsement Letter with Customer
  actor: Advisor
  to: Customer
  trigger: Insurer completes underwriting and issues Endorsement Letter (EL)
  sub_steps:
  - id: '5.1'
    action: Receive Endorsement Letter from insurer

    status: null

    status: null

2. Raise the request through the endorsement module and send it to the insurer.

4. Send the documents to the insurer. Their underwriting team will decide whether to accept the PED or not.
5. Share the Endorsement Letter (EL) with the customer once the process is completed.


Mandatory Documents: First Consultation Paper (FCP), Medical History Paper, Lab Test Reports, and Latest Prescription (if applicable).

Things to remember: Customer’s written consent from their registered email ID is mandatory. The customer must mention the exact diagnosis in the email body along with the disease history.

    note: Use customer's registered email ID for all communication
    on_error: Resend email or verify email address
  - id: '1.2'

      ID

      History Paper, Lab Test Reports, Latest Prescription if applicable)
    required: Yes (Mandatory)
    validation: Check all required documents are received and complete
    note: Collect documents in advance; latest prescription only if applicable
    on_error: Follow up with customer for missing/incomplete documents
  decisions:
  - when: 1.1 = false
    action: Resend email or verify email address with customer
    status: null
  - when: 1.2 = false

    status: null

    action: Proceed to STEP_2
    status: null

  - when: 3.2 = false

    status: null
  - when: All sub-steps complete

    status: null

2. Raise the request through the endorsement module and send it to the insurer.
3. The insurer may ask for additional medical documents — collect them from the customer if not already received.
4. Send the documents to the insurer. Their underwriting team will decide whether to accept the PED or not.
5. Share the Endorsement Letter (EL) with the customer once the process is completed.


Mandatory Documents: First Consultation Paper (FCP), Medical History Paper, Lab Test Reports, and Latest Prescription (if applicable).

    status: null

  - id: '2.2'

    validation: Confirm documents and request are sent to insurer

  - when: 2.2 = false

    validation: Verify if requested documents are available
    note: Check against previously collected documents
    on_error: Proceed to collect missing documents
  - id: '3.2'
    action: If not received, request additional documents from customer
    required: Conditional
    validation: Confirm receipt of additional documents from customer
    note: Specify exactly what documents are needed as per insurer's request
    on_error: Follow up with customer for pending documents
  - id: '3.3'
    action: Collect and validate additional documents from customer
    required: Conditional
    validation: Check completeness and relevance of documents
    note: Ensure documents match insurer's requirements

    status: null
  - when: 4.2 = false
    action: Follow up with insurer for underwriting decision
    status: null
  - when: All sub-steps complete
    action: Proceed to STEP_5
    status: null

    action: Receive Endorsement Letter (EL) from insurer

    validation: Verify EL is received and matches policy details
    note: Check for accuracy and completeness
    on_error: Follow up with insurer for missing or incorrect EL
  - id: '5.2'
    action: Share Endorsement Letter with customer
    required: Yes (Mandatory)
    validation: Confirm customer has received EL

  - when: 5.1 = false

    status: null
  - when: 5.2 = false
    action: Resend EL to customer
    status: null

action_item:
1. Ask the customer (over email) which disease they want to add and request any related medical documents they have.
2. Raise the request through the endorsement module and send it to the insurer.
3. The insurer may ask for additional medical documents — collect them from the customer if not already received.
4. Send the documents to the insurer. Their underwriting team will decide whether to accept the PED or not.
5. Share the Endorsement Letter (EL) with the customer once the process is completed.


Mandatory Documents: First Consultation Paper (FCP), Medical History Paper, Lab Test Reports, and Latest Prescription (if applicable).

Things to remember: Customer’s written consent from their registered email ID is mandatory. The customer must mention the exact diagnosis in the email body along with the disease history.

NOTE-  Always collect the required documents in advance.
structured_sop_yaml:
steps:
- name: Collect PED Addition Details and Documents from Customer
  actor: Advisor
  to: Customer
  trigger: Customer requests PED addition or advisor initiates PED addition process
  sub_steps:
  - id: '1.1'
    action: Send email to customer asking which disease they want to add
    required: Yes (Mandatory)
    validation: Verify email sent to customer's registered email ID
    note: Use customer's registered email ID for all communication
    on_error: Resend email or contact customer via alternate channel
  - id: '1.2'
    action: Request customer to provide all related medical documents (FCP, Medical
      History Paper, Lab Test Reports, Latest Prescription if applicable)
    required: Yes (Mandatory)
    validation: Check if all mandatory documents are received
    note: Collect all required documents in advance
    on_error: Follow up with customer for missing documents
  - id: '1.3'
    action: Request customer to provide written consent from their registered email
      ID
    required: Yes (Mandatory)
    validation: Verify consent is received from registered email ID
    note: Consent must mention exact diagnosis and disease history in email body
    on_error: Request customer to resend consent with required details
  - id: '1.4'
    action: Verify that customer has mentioned exact diagnosis and disease history
      in the email body
    required: Yes (Mandatory)
    validation: Check email content for diagnosis and disease history
    note: Do not proceed without complete information
    on_error: Ask customer to update email with missing details
  decisions:
  - when: 1.1 = false or 1.2 = false or 1.3 = false or 1.4 = false
    action: Follow up with customer for missing information or documents
    status: null
  - when: All sub-steps complete
    action: Proceed to STEP_2
    status: null
- name: Raise Endorsement Request and Send to Insurer
  actor: Advisor
  to: Insurer (via System)
  trigger: All required details and documents received from customer
  sub_steps:
  - id: '2.1'
    action: Raise PED addition request through endorsement module
    required: Yes (Mandatory)
    validation: Verify request is logged in endorsement module
    note: Attach all collected documents and consent
    on_error: Retry submission or escalate to technical support
  - id: '2.2'
    action: Send the endorsement request and documents to the insurer
    required: Yes (Mandatory)
    validation: Confirm insurer has received the request and documents
    note: Ensure all documents are attached
    on_error: Resend documents or contact insurer for confirmation
  decisions:
  - when: 2.1 = false or 2.2 = false
    action: Retry or escalate as appropriate
    status: null
  - when: All sub-steps complete
    action: Proceed to STEP_3
    status: null
- name: Respond to Insurer's Request for Additional Medical Documents
  actor: Advisor
  to: Customer (for collection), Insurer (for submission)
  trigger: Insurer requests additional medical documents
  sub_steps:
  - id: '3.1'
    action: Check if additional medical documents requested by insurer are already
      received
    required: 'Yes'
    validation: Compare insurer's request with documents on file
    note: If already received, proceed to next step
    on_error: Review document checklist
  - id: '3.2'
    action: If not received, request additional documents from customer
    required: Conditional
    validation: Verify receipt of requested documents from customer
    note: Specify exactly what is needed as per insurer's request
    on_error: Follow up with customer until documents are received
  decisions:
  - when: 3.1 = false and 3.2 = false
    action: Follow up with customer for pending documents
    status: null
  - when: All sub-steps complete
    action: Proceed to STEP_4
    status: null
- name: Send All Medical Documents to Insurer for Underwriting Decision
  actor: Advisor
  to: Insurer
  trigger: All required and additional documents are available
  sub_steps:
  - id: '4.1'
    action: Send all collected medical documents to insurer
    required: Yes (Mandatory)
    validation: Confirm insurer has received all required documents
    note: Include any additional documents requested by insurer
    on_error: Resend documents or contact insurer for confirmation
  decisions:
  - when: 4.1 = false
    action: Resend documents or escalate to insurer support
    status: null
  - when: All sub-steps complete
    action: Proceed to STEP_5
    status: null
- name: Share Endorsement Letter with Customer
  actor: Advisor
  to: Customer
  trigger: Insurer completes underwriting and issues Endorsement Letter (EL)
  sub_steps:
  - id: '5.1'
    action: Share Endorsement Letter (EL) with customer
    required: Yes (Mandatory)
    validation: Confirm customer has received EL
    note: Send via email to registered email ID
    on_error: Resend EL or contact customer for confirmation
  decisions:
  - when: 5.1 = false
    action: Resend EL or follow up with customer
    status: null
  - when: All sub-steps complete
    action: 'STATUS: COMPLETED'
    status: COMPLETED

  Actor: Advisor
  To: Customer
  Trigger: Customer requests change in proposer details

  SUB_STEPS:
    - 1.1: Request customer to share written consent from the registered email ID
      Required: Yes (Mandatory)
      Validation: Verify consent is received from registered email ID
      Note: Consent must be in writing and from the email registered with the policy
      On Error: Follow up with customer; clarify requirement if not received
    - 1.2: Request customer to share details to be changed
      Required: Yes (Mandatory)
      Validation: Check that all required change details are provided
      Note: Details must match the policy records for correction
      On Error: Request missing details from customer
    - 1.3: Request customer to share valid government ID proof
      Required: Yes (Mandatory)
      Validation: Verify ID proof is valid and matches customer identity
      Note: Acceptable IDs: Aadhaar, PAN, Passport, etc.
      On Error: Request valid ID proof again from customer

  DECISIONS:
    - WHEN: 1.1 = false
      ACTION: Remind customer to send written consent from registered email ID
    - WHEN: 1.2 = false
      ACTION: Request customer to provide details to be changed
    - WHEN: 1.3 = false
      ACTION: Request customer to provide valid government ID proof
    - WHEN: All sub-steps complete
      ACTION: Proceed to STEP_2

--------------------------------------------------

STEP_2: Initiate Endorsement Process
  Actor: Advisor
  To: Insurer (via System)
  Trigger: All required documents and consent received from customer

  SUB_STEPS:
    - 2.1: Raise a ticket through the endorsement module
      Required: Yes (Mandatory)
      Validation: Confirm ticket is created in the system
      Note: Use endorsement module specific to Magma policies
      On Error: Retry ticket creation; escalate to IT support if system error
    - 2.2: Submit the ticket and all collected documents to the insurer for endorsement
      Required: Yes (Mandatory)
      Validation: Verify submission confirmation from system/insurer
      Note: Attach all documents collected in Step 1
      On Error: Resubmit documents; follow up with insurer if not acknowledged

  DECISIONS:
    - WHEN: 2.1 = false
      ACTION: Attempt to raise ticket again or escalate to IT support
    - WHEN: 2.2 = false
      ACTION: Resubmit documents and ticket to insurer; follow up if needed
    - WHEN: All sub-steps complete
      ACTION: Proceed to STEP_3

--------------------------------------------------

STEP_3: Communicate Endorsement Turnaround Time (TAT)
  Actor: Advisor
  To: Customer
  Trigger: Ticket and documents submitted to insurer

  SUB_STEPS:
    - 3.1: Share the endorsement TAT (7-10 working days) with the customer
      Required: Yes (Mandatory)
      Validation: Confirm customer has acknowledged TAT communication
      Note: Standard TAT for Magma: 7-10 working days
      On Error: Resend TAT information to customer

  DECISIONS:
    - WHEN: 3.1 = false
      ACTION: Resend TAT information to customer
    - WHEN: All sub-steps complete
      ACTION: Proceed to STEP_4

--------------------------------------------------

STEP_4: Validate and Share Endorsed Documents; Close Ticket
  Actor: Advisor
  To: Customer
  Trigger: Insurer shares Endorsed Letter or updated Policy Copy

  SUB_STEPS:
    - 4.1: Validate the Endorsed Letter or updated Policy Copy received from insurer
      Required: Yes (Mandatory)
      Validation: Check that changes are as requested and document is authentic
      Note: Only corrections allowed; mid-term proposer change not permitted
      On Error: Contact insurer for clarification or correction
    - 4.2: Share the validated Endorsed Letter or updated Policy Copy with the customer
      Required: Yes (Mandatory)
      Validation: Confirm customer has received the document
      Note: Send via registered email or preferred communication channel
      On Error: Resend document to customer
    - 4.3: Close the ticket in the system
      Required: Yes (Mandatory)
      Validation: Verify ticket status is updated to closed
      Note: Ensure all customer queries are resolved before closing
      On Error: Attempt to close ticket again; escalate if system error

  DECISIONS:
    - WHEN: 4.1 = false
      ACTION: Contact insurer for clarification or correction
    - WHEN: 4.2 = false
      ACTION: Resend document to customer
    - WHEN: 4.3 = false
      ACTION: Attempt to close ticket again or escalate to IT support
    - WHEN: All sub-steps complete
      ACTION: STATUS: COMPLETED
      STATUS: COMPLETED

--------------------------------------------------

action_item:
1. Ask the customer to share written consent from the registered email ID along with the details to be changed.

2. Follow the endorsement process - raise a ticket through the endorsement module and submit it to the insurer for endorsement.

3. Share the endorsement TAT with the customer (standard TAT: 7-10 working days).

4. Once the insurer shares the Endorsed Letter or updated Policy Copy, validate it and share it with customer to close the ticket.

Note: Mid-term add-on or rider correction is subject to the insurer’s T&Cs, and the endorsement process varies from insurer to insurer.
